name: PT ITSEC Asia Tbk
summary: PT ITSEC Asia Tbk provides cybersecurity solution and services in the Asia Pacific region. It offers information security process manager; VPN monitoring; managed security service software solutions; and consulting services. The company also provides penetration testing and red teaming; audit, risk assurance, and compliance; managed security; security solution integration; V-CISCO; threat hunting and compromise assessment; information security analysis; OT/IoT security; application security; and digital forensics and incident response services. In addition, it offers IntelliBron, a software solution to protect from cyber-attacks. Further, the company provides fraud management, DevSecOps, security operations center, and personal data protection solutions. It serves financial, telecommunications, energy, transportation, manufacturing, and other industries. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
